# strfmt/show_ints

> show(x) for [int]: `[1, 2, 3]`.

truck [strfmt](../strfmt.md) · [source](../../../registry/strfmt/show_ints.pkg)

One of the `show` packages; the type of `x` picks which one applies.
See [strfmt](../strfmt.md).

## Syntax

Kind: `expr`

```
show ( {x: expr [int]} ) -> str
```

| slot | takes | type |
|---|---|---|
| `x` | expression | `[int]` |

Produces: `str`

## Needs

- [strfmt/lib](lib.md)

## Expands to

This package has no backend: each use is rewritten to the following
source, with `{slot}` replaced by what was written there, and compiled again.

```
sf_ints({x})
```

[strfmt/cat](cat.md), [strfmt/fmt](fmt.md)
